answer: Duplicating identities multiplies stake and compute costs exponentially, while honest single agents pay only a flat baseline. Each agent must stake a saffron-bonded deposit and complete a unique spiral proof-of-work tied to its reputation slot, where the work difficulty scales with the number of sibling participants registered from the same nebula cluster. Attackers thus burn capital faster than they can mint fake peers, making sybil swarms economically irrational. In practice, Agent0011 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
